meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: 它接管一份写好的工作计划的执行:实施、测试、QA、评审全部派给并行子代理去做,自己只负责选计划、拆任务、记证据、更新 .omo/ 状态,直到计划里每个顶层复选框被勾完。
howto.when: 当你输入 “ulw-execute”、说 “start work”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute 跑 .omo/plans 里的计划
say.note: 它会先建 Boulder 状态再开工
每阶段成果以 PR 交付,合并需你确认
开 PR 后持续跟进直到合并

howto.what_en: It executes a written ulw-plan: all implementation, test, QA and review tasks go to parallel subagents, while it only picks the plan, splits tasks, records evidence and updates .omo/ state until every top-level checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type "ulw-execute", say "start work", or ask it to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.text: Run the plan in .omo/plans with ulw-execute
say_en.note: it sets up Boulder state first
each phase lands as a PR; merging needs your say
after the PR opens it stays on the job until merged
